title: Khnumhotep II
summary: Khnumhotep II, governor whose tomb at Beni Hasan holds the mural Scott dates c. 1892–1876 BC.
description: Added from the Dynasty of Slaves import. Display only. Scott’s synchronisms are his view. This chronology never sets a sort, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Dynasty of Slaves is display-only and never sets a sort).

reign.note: Mural timing he equates with Abram’s entry. He identifies Abisha with Abram.

reign.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Appendix, Egyptian Inscriptions & Papyri
reign.note: Beni Hasan mural date. 1876 BC, his arrival year, is the late end. He identifies Abisha with Abraham.

reign.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Appendix, Archaeological Reports & Site Data
reign.note: Reign of Senusret II for the Beni Hasan painting. 1890 BC falls inside the mural range c. 1892–1876 BC.
